description: MarketingOS outcome observation intake record. Synthetic fixtures must set synthetic:true and are never journaled as real outcomes.

artifact_id.description: Ledgered artifact identity, e.g. the mp4 filename or VideoSpec ref.

claim_ledger_ref.description: Path or id of the claim ledger the observed artifact was compiled from.

confounders.description: Required when causality=correlated; listed known confounders.

metric.description: What was measured, e.g. views, comments, demo_requests.

source.description: Where the observation came from, e.g. provider receipt, manual log.

synthetic.description: true only for validator fixtures; real intake records must set false or omit.

value.description: The measured value; number or short string.

window.description: Observation window; a window is OPEN until window_end passes or the period is abandoned with a recorded reason.

title: MarketingOS outcome observation
